notes: 1. Registration prefix used in this module = GHNG-NNNNNNNNNN-X (e.g. GHNG-2000000014-A). The Sales Manager (SM) searches buyers by name, phone number, OR registration number. The search uses a MySQL LIKE %term% against User.phone / firstName / lastName plus RegistrationUnit.registrationNumber; minimum query length is 5 trimmed characters and the search is debounced 500 ms.

2. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] = a disposable UAT record/unit/registration in the correct state must be supplied before executing this test (e.g. a PREALLOCATED registration to reach checkout, an AVAILABLE pool unit to hold, a WINNER registration to reach the KYC link). Ask the user for the exact campaign + registration number + phone to use. Known UAT seed (campaign 295 'Test New Physical Campaign', RUNNING in the capture window): phone 7666470638 / GHNG-2000000014-A (Anjali WhatsAppTemp, PREALLOCATED, units Crest 1404 / Crest 1407 / Aspire 2805); phone 7020527871 / GHNG-2000000024-A (aman guptaa, PREALLOCATED, Aura); phone 9167746035 / GHNG-2000000009-Y (Supriya Dubey, HOLD). These may have changed — confirm before relying on them.
3. [VERIFY WITH DEV] = behaviour not confirmed in BRD/FRD/FS/Workflow or only inferred from source/visual-memory; confirm before treating Pass/Fail as authoritative.

4. MUTATION-AUTHORISATION WARNING: Physical Allocation WRITES to live, stateful UAT data. Selecting a unit and clicking 'Proceed to Pay' fires PUT /update-unit-status (places a 20-minute Redis HOLD) and POST /allocation-order; completing payment marks the unit BOOKED and the registration WINNER (irreversible without admin rollback); 'Submit KYC' fires POST /kyc/submit (generates a PDF, uploads to Azure, syncs to LeadSquared). Every destructive / state-changing TC below carries [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] and MUST NOT be executed on UAT without explicit user authorisation and a disposable record — UAT accounts are stateful and one-shot. Capture-only steps (open a screen, click a unit card to view pricing, open a drawer/modal, read a cost sheet) are SAFE because clicking a unit card only fetches pricing (GET allocation-unit-details) and performs NO mutation — the hold + order fire only on 'Proceed to Pay'.

5. CLICKING A UNIT CARD IS NON-DESTRUCTIVE: per source (handleUnitClick), selecting/deselecting a unit card only toggles local state and calls GET allocation-unit-details for pricing. No PUT /update-unit-status runs until 'Proceed to Pay'. So pricing, cost sheet, payment schedule and cart preview can all be asserted without authorisation; only Proceed to Pay / payment / KYC submit need it.

6. CAMPAIGN-DRIVEN MODULE: Physical Allocation only works while a PHYSICAL_EVENT campaign is RUNNING for the SM's project. When no campaign is active the landing shows a '🏢 No Active Campaign' idle card and the search input + 'Scan QR' button are DISABLED. The active-campaign name is NOT rendered anywhere on the page — the only visible cue is the search input being enabled. The global header strip 'India's Biggest Growth Housing Revolution Begins On 7th April 2026.' is static marketing chrome, NOT campaign-driven.

7. THREE SUB-ROUTES form the pipeline: /physical-allocation (CustomerSearchPage — always reachable), /physical-allocation/checkout (UnitAllocationPage — guarded: redirects to /physical-allocation if no customer is in navigation state), /physical-allocation/kyc (KycPage — renders a BLANK white page, no crash/redirect, if no customerContext is in navigation state).

8. ALLOCATION GLOSSARY: PREALLOCATED = registration has units assigned to it before the event (shown as 'Not Started' pill in the registration card); HOLD = registration is under verification / already paying (shown as 'Verification' pill); WINNER = unit fully booked + paid (shown as 'Booked' pill, and ONLY then does the 'KYC & E-Sign' link replace the 'Common Pool' button); AVAILABLE / HOLD / BOOKED = unit-card states (green / orange / red badges). Pre Allocated Units = units already attached to the registration; Common Pool = browsable shared inventory opened via the 'Common Pool' button/drawer. Unit Allocation Cart = the right-rail list of units chosen for this checkout with a Combined Payable Amount.

9. KYC LINK VISIBILITY: the 'KYC & E-Sign' link in the Pre Allocated Units card header is rendered ONLY when the active registration is WINNER (unit already paid). For PREALLOCATED / HOLD the same slot shows the 'Common Pool' button instead. None of the seeded UAT registrations were WINNER during capture, so the populated KYC form and the confirmation/success screen were NOT captured — every KYC-form-content TC therefore carries [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] + [VERIFY WITH DEV] and must use a real WINNER registration. Direct nav to /kyc was captured (blank state).

10. SILENT-BY-DESIGN: clicking a unit card performs no mutation and shows no toast (silent — verify the GET pricing call, not a toast). Per CLAUDE.md Pipeline Discipline rule #6, a missing toast/confirmation is NOT a bug if the backend side-effect occurred. Notification dispatch (SMS/WhatsApp via Kaleyra) is documented only on payment success/failure and on KYC sync to LeadSquared — assert presence/absence per the source, not by assumption.

11. SM auth = Mobile-OTP only (no password). UAT mobile = 8888888888, SM static OTP = 258369. SM portal base = https://uat-web.xrportal.in/sales-manager. The SM sidebar shows three nav items — Callback Requests, Towers, Allocation (the 'Allocation' tile is this module and shows a green selected state) — plus a Logout button.

12. LeadSquared (LSQ) is EXCLUDED from direct test scope (no LSQ credentials / API calls per project constraints): the KYC->LSQ sync and VC->LSQ sync are asserted only as 'the portal-side action completed and the downstream sync was attempted' [VERIFY WITH DEV]; do not call LSQ directly. Strapi is out of scope. The 20-minute hold and BOOKED/WINNER transition are driven by the payment-gateway webhook (Easebuzz/Razorpay) which is the source of truth — never inferred from the browser.
